        Responsibilities:
        - McpAuthenticationFilter: extracts the Bearer token and populates the SecurityContextHolder
        - McpAuthenticationToken: Spring Security token with model.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.Jwt as the principal
        - TokenExtractor: converts provider.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.JwtClaims into the custom model.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.Jwt
        - AuthAdapterAutoConfig: SecurityFilterChain and Spring Security beans
        - AuthAdapterProperties: keycloak.adapter.* configuration
        - McpAuthorizationAdvisor: AOP-based authorization by role/scope
        Depends on adapter-auth-idp for pure JWT validation.

items.title:
io.keelframework.mcp.adapters:keel-adapter-auth-idp 1.0.0 发布, Librería de validación JWT pura — sin Spring Security, sin filtros HTTP.
        Responsabilidades:
        - Descargar y cachear JWKS de RedHat SSO (JwksRemoteLoader, JwksKeyResolver)
        - Validar firma, expiración, issuer y audience del JWT (TokenValidator)
        - Modelos propios: model.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.Jwt, model.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.Role, model.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.Scope, model.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.Authority, provider.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.JwtClaims
        No depende de transport-auth-service ni de ningún módulo de transport.
